thread:
maya.partnerships: Quick sync — EdgePartner wants a single distribution bundle we can list on their marketplace + our marketplace. Need alignment on contents, licensing blurb, and an embargoed announce window. Targeting Wed EOD embargo.

alex.legal: Thanks — high level Q: are we redistributing weighted model files or just a hosted runtime? Redistribution changes the license wording and export controls.

maya.partnerships: They'll host downloadable artifacts for on-prem customers (edge SI installs). So yes, binaries will be redistributed.

riley.hw-partner: Correct from our side. We need a signed artifact and a clear manifest so our installers can pull the right files (quantized and non-quant) and the checksum.

kevin.runtime: For serving we produce two variants: quantized int8 optimized binary + float16 reference. We can provide a shim docker that loads either. Suggesting packaging: model.tar.gz (float16), model-int8.tar.gz (quantized), runtime-shim.tar.gz, license.txt, sbom.json, checksums.sha256

sam.sre: +1 on checksums. Also need provenance headers for each artifact (builder git sha, toolchain, quantization recipe). We prefer a small manifest file:

```
manifest:
- name: edge-model-v1
  artifacts:
    - path: model.float16.tar.gz
      sha256: <sha256>
      provenance: git+https://git.redwood.ai/edge-builds@abcdef
    - path: model.int8.tar.gz
      sha256: <sha256>
      provenance: ...
  license: MIT-Redistribution? (TBD)
```

alex.legal: Stop on "MIT-Redistribution" — legal needs the exact license text. If it's an OSI license we need attribution + patent grant clarity. If it's a custom redistribution license we'll need countersigned addendum from the model provider. Also export classification: ask model provider for ECCN/CCATS or the export control self-attestation. Without that, downstream SI installs may be blocked in certain regions.

tanya.marketplace: For marketplace listing we need: 1) SKU id, 2) short description (1 sentence), 3) long blurb, 4) icons/screenshots, 5) allowed regions list, 6) pricing tier mapping (free trial / paid). Can we get draft copy from partnerships?

maya.partnerships: I'll draft the blurb. Quick ask to partners: can they confirm allowed distribution geos and provide a license artifact (license.txt) and export self-attestation by Tue EOB?

riley.hw-partner: We can provide license.txt and export attestation but need a template for the attestation. Also need preferred SKU naming convention — we use EDGE-<partner>-<model>-v1.

kevin.runtime: One more technical: quantized artifact must include a quant-cfg.json documenting calibration dataset and algorithm (LSQ etc.). This is required for reproducibility and for our compatibility tests.

alex.legal: On embargo and joint announcement: marketing must sign off on the license language used in the public assets. If there's a distributor addendum, marketing should avoid publishing the redistribution clause in PR.

tanya.marketplace: Proposed timeline:
- Tue AM: partners provide license.txt + export attestation + sample manifest
- Tue PM: legal reviews license text
- Wed AM: engineering produces packaging + checksums + sbom
- Wed EOD: gated embargo release to partner marketplaces

maya.partnerships: Sounds tight but doable. I'll ping partner for docs now. Action items:
- @riley.hw-partner: send license.txt and export attestation template by Tue 12pm
- @kevin.runtime: publish packaging checklist and quant-cfg example by Tue 5pm
- @alex.legal: review license and confirm redistribution wording by Tue 8pm
- @tanya.marketplace: reserve SKU and draft marketplace copy by Tue 6pm
- @sam.sre: add artifact verification step to onboarding playbook and include SBOM ingestion

deploy-bot: Reminder: create ephemeral release channel when packaging artifacts uploaded -> #release-edge-1719456789

riley.hw-partner: Will do, sending over a draft license + attestation this afternoon. Also, can you confirm whether we need Signed Attestation (PGP) for the artifacts or standard TLS download is okay?

kevin.runtime: Signed attestation preferred for integrity chain. We'll verify PGP signatures during ingest and include signature verification in the onboarding CI.

alex.legal: PGP signatures are fine. We'll include signature validation clause in the redistribution addendum. Also, we'll need a short privacy blurb if the model collects any telemetry.

maya.partnerships: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate responses and post an updated manifest + timeline here. If legal approves Tuesday, we'll aim for Wed embargo. :thumbsup:
